items.text: Career guidance after B.Com is built for the specific fork commerce graduates actually face: continuing or exiting a CA, CS, or CMA attempt already underway, M.Com versus an MBA versus a direct job, or a banking or government exam attempt.

The point is to choose the path tied to a real, high-value skill portfolio instead of the most familiar option, so this stage starts unlocking stronger income opportunities and earlier financial freedom.
